lecturers.name: Ratno Suprapto, S.Sn., M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Scientific Coordinator and Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Ratno Suprapto, S.Sn., M.Ds. completed his bachelor's degree in Visual Communication Design, then continued his studies with a Master's degree in Design at ITB. He is active as a lecturer and practitioner in the field of visual communication design, with an interest in visual strategy, brand identity, and the study of visual representation in media and advertising.
His research interests focus on the exploration of symbolic and narrative elements in visual media, particularly within the context of popular culture and the creative industry in Indonesia. His publications include analyses of the visual identities of professional football clubs, death metal music album covers, and the use of visual metaphors in television advertising. He also examines the use of animal characters as a form of endorsement in advertising, as well as creative strategies with a Unique Selling Proposition approach in automotive advertising campaigns. Through his works, Ratno highlights the interconnection between design, visual messages, and socio-cultural contexts in visual communication practices in Indonesia.

lecturers.name: Retno Purwanti M. S.Sn., M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Head and Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Retno Purwanti M. S.Sn., M.Ds. completed her Master's degree in Design in 2013 at Trisakti University. Her professional career began as an art director and illustrator in print media, then expanded into the world of broadcasting as a motion graphic designer at SCTV for more than ten years. Since 2007, she has been actively teaching as a part-time lecturer at various private universities, eventually becoming a full-time lecturer at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya after completing her master's degree. Her extensive experience as a design practitioner and educator shapes her approach to integrating academic and industry aspects in visual communication design.
His research interests focus on sustainable design, community empowerment through design, and visual approaches as tools for social and educational communication. His publications cover topics such as the implementation of sustainable design in contemporary masks made from recycled paper, the design of signage systems for educational institutions, and visual design for visual stimulation in children with strabismus. She has also written about board games as a medium for social learning, animated videos as traffic safety campaigns, and awareness of the dangers of beauty standards in cosmetic advertisements. Through her work, she highlights the potential of design as a medium for empowerment, education, and social transformation in urban Indonesian society.
:
retno.purwanti@upj.ac.id

lecturers.name: Rifki Risandhy, S.Des., M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Student Coordinator and Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Rifki Risandhy, S.Ds., M.Ds. completed his master's degree in design (master's degree information not specified, can be added if available). He began his professional career as a graphic design practitioner in 2009 at Global TV, then continued as a Motion Graphics Designer at Metro TV in 2011. His teaching career began in 2013 as an instructor at SMK Multimedia & Animation Bina Informatika Bintaro. Since 2015, he has been actively serving as a lecturer in the Visual Communication Design program at Tarumanagara University and Muhammadiyah University of Tangerang. In 2023, he joined as a lecturer in the Visual Communication Design program at Pembangunan Jaya University.
His research interests include the development of motion graphics, animation, digital art, and the exploration of technology's role in the creative process, particularly artificial intelligence in the world of art and design. His works are documented through various publications, such as the development of motion graphics videos for Jaipong dance art, the design of 2D and 3D animated films themed around the diversity of Indonesian batik, and studies on the challenges and opportunities of using Artificial Intelligence Art for graphic designers. He also researches the impact of AI in design through motion graphics media. In addition to writing, Rifki has participated in international video art exhibitions, such as the RE:KARYA International Video Festival (2023) with his work titled “The Chaos of Beauty.” Through his academic and artistic works, he highlights the dynamics between technology, creativity, and contemporary visual culture

lecturers.name: Tommi, S.Ds., M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Secretary and Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Tommi, S.Ds., M.Ds. completed his master's degree in design at Trisakti University after earning a bachelor's degree in Visual Communication Design from the Indonesian Computer University. With over a decade of experience as a graphic designer and art director, he has collaborated with various major brands such as Halodoc, XL Axiata, BINUS Group, the Indonesian Ministry of Tourism, Morinaga-Kino, Bali United, and AirAsia. Since 2021, he has been actively teaching at Bunda Mulia University and Pembangunan Jaya University.
His research interests focus on visual branding, semiotics, and brand humanization in the context of promotions and campaigns. His publications explore logos as representations of social values, redesigning campaign media for youth education, and semiotics analysis in visual identity. He examines how visual strategies can shape perceptions, values, and emotional connections between brands and their audiences.

lecturers.name: Desi Dwi Kristanto, S.Ds., M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Vice Dean of Faculty of Technology & Design and Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Desi Dwi Kristanto,.began his academic career as an Assistant Lecturer in the Product Design Study Program at the Bandung Institute of Technology (2006–2010), then joined the Visual Communication Design Study Program at Multimedia Nusantara University as a full time lecturer in 2011. At that institution, he served as Head of the Program (2012) and Dean of the Faculty of Arts & Design (2013). Since December 2017, he has been a lecturer and Head of the Visual Communication Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
His primary interests include 3D animation, interaction design, and design and entrepreneurship. His research covers various themes such as visual effects in animated films, virtual item trading in online games, parenting app design, social campaign media development, and graphic design for the empowerment of SMEs and local products. He is also actively involved in community service projects and interdisciplinary collaborations, particularly those focused on design innovation in the context of education, culture, and the creative economy.

lecturers.name: Achmad Nur Kholis, S.Sn., M.Sn.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Achmad Nur Kholis, S.Sn., M.Sn. is a graduate of the Fine Arts Study Program with a focus on art studies. He pursued his master's degree at the Postgraduate Fine Arts Study Program at Sebelas Maret University, Surakarta, with a concentration in history and culture studies. His academic background has fostered a strong interest in teaching, research, and community service, particularly in the fields of art, design, and culture.
He has extensive experience in art studies through research and the development of knowledge based on local wisdom. This interest is reflected in his participation in various seminars and national and international publications highlighting art aesthetics, traditional arts, culture, and local wisdom values that can be developed across disciplines.
With the motto “Do your best and believe in yourself,” Achmad Nur Kholis continues to advance as a professional academic committed to the development of art and cultural studies.

lecturers.name: Muhammad Tafakur , S. Ds. , M.Ds.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Muhammad Tafakur is a graphic designer and illustrator with nearly six years of experience in the creative and corporate industries. Currently, he serves as a lecturer at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ), where he shares his expertise in visual communication and design.
His work and research focus on ethical visual storytelling and the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in visual communication design. He is also actively involved in the development of environmental graphic design, user interface/user experience (UI/UX) design, and illustration. Through a collaborative and exploratory approach, Muhammad Tafakur continues to push the boundaries of visual creativity within the context of technology and contemporary social issues.

lecturers.name: Afusa Nidya Kinasih, S.Sn. M.Sn.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Visual Communication Design
lecturers.bio:
Afusa Nindya is a lecturer in Visual Communication Design with special expertise in photography and visual research. Her primary academic focus includes developing photography teaching methods, exploring visual media, and conducting research related to photography, film, visual culture, and social media.
In addition to teaching, she is actively involved in scientific publications and community service activities related to art, design, and visual culture. Her interest in contemporary issues in visual representation drives her contributions to academic discussions and creative practices at both the local and international levels.

lecturers.name: Novy Silvia Dewi, SE, MM, CCFA, Ph.D.
lecturers.role: Head of Accounting Department and Lecturer of Accounting Department
lecturers.bio:
Novy Silvia Dewi is a lecturer at the Accounting Study Program of Pembangunan Jaya University. She completed her Bachelor of Accounting at Trisakti University, Master of Finance at Gadjah Mada University, and earned her Doctor of Accounting degree from Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM), Malaysia.
Prior to joining UPJ, Novy served as the Head of Accounting Program at PPM Manajemen. Her research interests include financial accounting, auditing, fraud, and management accounting. She has published various scientific papers in national and international forums and journals, including on the topics of PSAK 72, fraud detection, and internal auditor effectiveness in the context of big data.
Novy is also active as an international journal reviewer and has professional certifications as a Certified Corporate Forensic Auditor (CCFA) and Assessor Profession from the National Professional Certification Agency of the Republic of Indonesia.

lecturers.role: Secretary of Accounting Department and Lecturer of Accounting Department
lecturers.bio:
Farhan Ady Pratama, S.E., M.Ak. is a lecturer in the Accounting Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. He earned his Bachelor's and Master's of Accounting degrees from Trisakti University. Before joining the academic world, Farhan worked for 4.5 years as an accountant in a manufacturing company and was a teaching assistant at his alma mater.
Farhan's research interests include Financial Accounting, Sustainable Accounting, Good Corporate Governance, and Risk Management. He actively publishes scientific papers, including in iCARE 2023, KIA 9 and 10, SAME 6, EBIC UNPAM, and community service activities through Accurate accounting software training in vocational schools.

lecturers.name: Dr. Irma Paramita Sofia, S.E., Ak., M.Ak., CA.
lecturers.role: Student Affairs Coordinator and Lecturer of Accounting Department
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Irma Paramita Sofia, S.E., Ak., M.Ak., CA. completed her Bachelor of Economics in Accounting from Universitas Brawijaya, then earned a Master of Accounting from Universitas Indonesia, and a Doctor of Accounting from Trisakti University. She has served as the Head of Accounting Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya since June 2021.
Before her academic career, Irma had experience as a consultant at Ernst & Young (Big 4) Public Accounting Firm, with assignments in internal audit, risk control, business process management, as well as control testing and end-user computing systems.
Her research focuses on green accounting, intellectual capital, and management accounting, emphasizing the social aspects and environmental sustainability. Irma has published scientific papers in various international reputable journals, including the International Journal of Professional Business Review, International Journal of Business, Economics and Law, and the South East Asia Journal of Contemporary Business, and contributed to the book Urban Development and Lifestyle (Nova Science Publishers).

lecturers.name: Dr. Arry Eksandy, S.E., M.Ak.
lecturers.role: Scientific Coordinator and Lecturer of Accounting Department
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Arry Eksandy, S.E., M.Ak. is a lecturer in the Accounting Study Program of Universitas Pembangunan Jaya who focuses on research in the fields of corporate governance, risk management, compliance, and sustainability. He earned his Doctorate in Accounting from Trisakti University in 2022, after completing his Bachelor's and Master's degrees in the same field.
Before joining UPJ, Arry was the Vice Dean for Finance and Personnel at a private university in Tangerang. His work in the academic field is reflected in his contributions to a number of scientific publications, including in reputable journals such as the International Journal of Social Science and Business (IJSSB) and the International Journal of Economic, Business, Accounting, Agriculture Management and Sharia Administration (IJEBAS). Among others, the publication titled "Good Corporate Governance: Three Ways of Moderating Infrastructure Companies Should Be Aware“ (IJSSB, 2024) and ”What Are The Important Factors To Improving Economic Performance?" (IJEBAS, 2024) are highlights in the field of corporate governance and economic performance.
Arry is also active as a reviewer in various national journals and serves as editor-in-chief of the International Journal of Accounting, Management, Economics and Social Sciences, emphasizing his role in the development of accounting and management science at the national and international levels.

lecturers.role: Community Service Coordinator and Lecturer of Accounting Department
lecturers.bio:
Fitriyah Nurhidayah, S.E., M.Si. is a lecturer in the Accounting Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya with research interests in Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and Management Accounting. Currently, she is pursuing her Doctor of Accounting studies at Sultan Ageng Tirtayasa University. Previously, she has taught at various universities in Jakarta.
Fitriyah earned her Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Accounting from Trisakti University. She has contributed to several international publications, including the International Journal of Business, Economics and Law and the book Urban Development and Lifestyle, published by Nova Science Publishers. Her diverse academic experience and research focus on the SME sector make Fitriyah instrumental in bridging accounting theory with practice in the small and medium-scale business sector.

lecturers.bio:
Farhan Fadil Ghifari, M.Ak. is a lecturer in the Department of Accounting at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. He earned his bachelor's and master's degrees focusing on accounting. Previously, Fadil had experience as a Tax Leader in an oil company in Timika and as a Principal Tax Expert of PT Sucofindo in the Ministry of Investment, handling investment realization projects in Eastern Indonesia.
He now actively teaches taxation courses and serves as a tax advisor in the private sector. His research interests include tax compliance, e-filing, and transfer pricing. Some of his works are published in national and international journals, including in Central Asia & the Caucasus Journal.

lecturers.name: Danto Sukmajati, Ph.D
lecturers.role: Tourism Planner
lecturers.bio:
Danto Sukmajati earned his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 1999, then continued his master's and doctoral studies in Tourism Development at Universiti Sains Malaysia. He has more than two decades of teaching experience and has been a permanent lecturer at the Architecture Study Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya since 2022.
His research interests focus on tourism development, particularly urban tourism and heritage tourism. Additionally, he has been actively involved in studies on urban housing and settlement planning since the early 2000s, both as an expert and team leader. In the academic realm, Danto also teaches courses that bridge architecture and tourism, reflecting his integrated approach to the study of space and social dynamics within the context of regional development.

lecturers.name: Ar. Melania L. Pandiangan, M.T., IAI., GP.
lecturers.role: Licensed Architect
lecturers.bio:
Melania completed her bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2012, and continued her master's studies with a major in Architectural Design at the Bandung Institute of Technology in 2013. She is a member of the Indonesian Institute of Architects and is certified as a professional architect.
Before entering the academic world, Melania worked as an architectural practitioner at several consulting firms and was involved in various public building projects, including hospitals, apartments, academic buildings, government offices, and international airports. Her interests focus on architectural design that is sustainable with the urban context and airport architecture studies. Her approach reflects the integration between building scale and urban spatial planning, with particular attention to function, context, and the quality of public spaces.

lecturers.name: Rahma Purisari, M. Ars. , GP.
lecturers.role: Behavioral Architecture Expert
lecturers.bio:
Rahma Purisari earned a Bachelor of Engineering, Professional Architect Education (PPAr), and Master of Architecture from the Sepuluh Nopember Institute of Technology in Surabaya, with a focus on architectural design. Her design thesis, titled “Color as a Form Giver in the Surabaya Cancer Clinic in the Context of Healing Architecture,” reflects her interest in healing architecture and color-based spatial experiences.
Before teaching, she was actively involved as a professional architect in consulting and contracting firms, with experience in hospital planning projects, campus development, and master plan development. She also holds a Green Professional (GP) certification as a contribution to the development of green buildings in Indonesia. In the academic world, she teaches courses such as Architectural Design, Interior Space Design, and Site Design.
His research interests include green architecture, social and environmental sustainability, and the integration of public spaces and communities. Over the past five years, he has been actively writing and publishing various scientific articles in reputable national and international journals. His research topics include elements of worship spaces, passive strategies in green buildings, social sustainability in public spaces, and political representation in urban spaces. He has also contributed to several book publications on public spaces and sustainable architecture, including Bunga Rampai RPTRA (2020) and RD2D: Pointilism (2023). His work reflects his active engagement in bridging architectural practice with social and environmental issues in Indonesia's urban areas.

lecturers.name: Ratna Safitri, M.Ars., GP.
lecturers.role: Housing and Settlement Expert
lecturers.bio:
Ratna Safitri completed her Bachelor's degree in Architecture at Islamic University of Indonesia in Yogyakarta and pursued her Master's degree in Architecture, specializing in Housing and Settlement, at the University of Indonesia in Jakarta. Her thesis, titled "Settlement above Water and Urbanization: A Case Study of Telaga Mas Village in Balikpapan, East Kalimantan," sparked her interest in delving deeper into urban architecture and sustainable development. Ratna is actively involved in the field of architecture, specifically focusing on housing and settlement, ranging from landed housing to vertical housing. Her environmental concern led her to explore the topic of Green Architecture, and she holds a Green Professional certification from the Green Building Council (GBC) Indonesia.

lecturers.name: Surya Gunanta Tarigan, PhD
lecturers.role: Housing and Settlement Expert
lecturers.bio:
Surya completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2006 at the University of North Sumatra. He then continued his master's and doctoral studies at the School of Architecture, Planning and Landscape, Newcastle University, England. He obtained his master's degree in 2011 with a focus on Architecture and Planning Studies with Design, and completed his doctorate in 2016.
Before becoming active in academia, Surya gained extensive professional experience working at consulting firms, contractors, developers, and architectural firms in London. Upon returning to Indonesia, he worked in the retail and banking sectors while teaching in the master's program in architecture at a private university in Jakarta, before eventually joining the faculty at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
His research interests focus on housing and settlement issues, public policy, and urban dynamics in metropolitan areas. In recent years, he has been actively writing and publishing scientific articles, particularly related to post-COVID-19 pandemic workplace transformations, the development of private cities in Southeast Asia, and studies on social interactions in urban villages.

lecturers.name: Ar. Titus Adi Kurniawan, M.Ars, IAI.
lecturers.role: Interior Designer
lecturers.bio:
Titus completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2014, then continued his master's studies at the Bandung Institute of Technology in 2016. At the master's level, he focused his research on building technology, particularly related to fire safety in high-rise buildings, using a performance-based analysis approach.
Before pursuing an academic career, Titus was actively involved as a practitioner in various sectors of architecture, including property development (as a developer), architectural and interior design consulting, and participation in building and environmental planning projects. This experience laid a strong foundation for his integrative and technically grounded design approach.
His research interests include building technology, fire safety, and efficiency and safety in vertical building design. One of his scientific publications, titled “Fire Safety Parameters of High-Rise Residential Buildings: A Literature Review of Performance-Based Analysis Method,” was published in IOP Conference Series: Earth and Environmental Science in 2017.
His involvement in research and practice demonstrates a commitment to bridging architectural theory with technical and safety challenges in modern built environments.

lecturers.role: Parametric Design Expert
lecturers.bio:

A graduate in Engineering from Parahyangan Catholic University, Bandung, besides being active in academia, they are also a practicing architect with experience working at PDW Bureau and Andramatin before eventually establishing their own firm. They have a strong interest in contemporary geometric forms, computational aspects in architecture, as well as vernacular architecture.

lecturers.name: Issa Samichat Ismail Tafridj, MSc.
lecturers.role: Environmental Urban Planner
lecturers.bio:
Issa earned his Bachelor and Master of Architecture degrees from Diponegoro University through the Kemenristekdikti Fast Track program, then continued his studies at the University of Manchester, UK, and completed a second master's in Urban Regeneration and Development.
Prior to becoming a lecturer, he worked as a Knowledge Management Specialist for the City Planning Labs project at the World Bank Jakarta and as an Infrastructure Expert at Commission V of the House of Representatives. Currently, Issa serves as a Scientific Coordinator in the Architecture Study Program with a focus on urban regeneration, sustainable infrastructure, and integration of social aspects in design.
In the last five years, he has been actively conducting research related to private cities, residential satisfaction, social capital, and green design, with funding support from the Alexander von Humboldt Foundation, UPJ internal grants, and UPJ-UiTM research collaboration program. Her work highlights the interplay between space, policy, and social dynamics in urban areas.

lecturers.name: Lutfi Aulia Makarim, M.R.K.
lecturers.role: Urban Designer
lecturers.bio:
Karim completed his bachelor's degree in Architecture in 2017 at the National Institute of Technology, Bandung, and then continued his master's studies in Urban Design at the Bandung Institute of Technology starting in 2018. His education focused on strengthening his interest in sustainable and contextual urban planning and design.
Before entering the academic world, Karim was actively involved as an architectural practitioner in the property development and urban planning consulting sectors. He participated in various projects, ranging from masterplan design, commercial buildings, to residential developments in urban environments. This experience shaped his comprehensive design perspective, spanning from site-level to urban-scale.
His research interests focus on urban planning and design, with a particular emphasis on the integration of spatial functions and urban environmental quality. Additionally, Karim has a passion for architectural and urban photography, which he uses as a visual medium to explore the dynamics of urban space and form.

lecturers.role: Computational Design Expert

Sultan Yazid is an academic and architectural practitioner who joined Universitas Pembangunan Jaya in 2025. Previously, he taught at one of the private universities in Bandung and was an Assistant Lecturer at Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB). His focus on ecological architecture and computational design is reflected in his academic and professional work.
He has served as Computational Manager and Project Manager at RLA Studio, and Parametric Tutor at Klass Academy. One of his publications on modular and organic architecture was published in ARCADE Journal (2021).

He holds a Bachelor's degree in Product Design from the National Institute of Technology, Bandung, and a Master's degree in Design from the Bandung Institute of Technology. Additionally, he pursued a Ph.D. at Chiba University, Japan.
His focus in product design and research revolves around the processing and utilization of materials sourced from nature, such as bamboo and wood, to be used as the primary materials for various product creations. Beyond his academic role, Hari Nugraha has professional experience in several national manufacturing industries specializing in craft products, interior home appliances, and furniture.

lecturers.bio:
Alif is currently a designer, researcher, and educator with a background in product design, serving as a lecturer in the Product Design Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Jakarta, Indonesia. He graduated from Trisakti University in Indonesia and Universiti Teknologi MARA in Malaysia.
His main design and research interests revolve around ergonomics, toy design, transportation infrastructure design, rapid prototyping, and 3D printing.
Alif has experience working on various projects for multinational companies such as Suzuki, and has provided national-scale training for the National Museum of Indonesia. Additionally, he has been a speaker at several international seminars such as the Indonesia – Japan Joint Scientific Seminar (IJJS) and the Asia International Conference of Art & Design (AICAD).
Furthermore, Alif has been involved in developing the prototype for the Rinus C1 electric car design, which has become an icon of the Product Design Program at UPJ.

lecturers.name: Toufiq Panji Wisesa, S.Ds., M.Sn.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Product Design
lecturers.bio:
Toufiq Panji Wisesa, born in Bandung in 1983, pursued his undergraduate and postgraduate education at the Faculty of Fine Arts and Design, ITB (Bandung Institute of Technology). Panji, affectionately known as a ceramic designer, is actively involved in creating and has participated in various national and international art and design exhibitions.
Panji's artistic achievements include being a finalist in the Indonesia Art Award in 2010. He is recognized as an expert by the Ministry of Industry in the field of ceramics due to his contributions to the development of ceramic products in various regions. He has received several awards in his field, including Gold and Silver Medals at the Asia International Conference of Art and Design 2017 for the best product innovation category.

lecturers.name: Dr. Ida Nurhaida, M.T.
lecturers.role: Head and Lecturer of Informatics Department
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Ida Nurhaida, M.T., is a dedicated educator at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. Her academic journey started with a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from Hasanuddin University in 1993. Her thirst for knowledge led her to pursue a Master's degree in the same field from the prestigious University of Indonesia in 2010. Driven by a desire to push the boundaries of her expertise, she embarked on a doctoral program in Computer Science, also at UI, and successfully earned her Ph.D. in 2016. During her Ph.D. research, Ida Nurhaida had the opportunity to visit the University of Reading, UK, where she engaged in academic discourse, conducted comprehensive research, and collaborated with experts in the field of Computer Vision Research Group (CVRG) to deepen her understanding of Batik Motif and its cultural significance from a computer vision perspective.
Beyond her role as an educator, Dr. Ida Nurhaida is a passionate researcher, specializing in areas such as computer vision, image processing, data science, and network computing. Her research endeavors strive to unravel the intricacies of these domains, seeking practical applications that positively impact academia and industry. She engaged in research collaborations with esteemed institutions worldwide, from public and private universities in Indonesia (UI, UNAIR, Poltekkes, Universitas Bakrie) to renowned institutions in the UK (University of Reading, University of Coventry, University College London) and Malaysia (Universiti Sultan Zainal Abidin, University of Technology Malaysia). The collaborative ventures span multinational companies such as Ernst & Young, JATIS, and Hyundai Mobil Indonesia, facilitating student internships and educational partnerships.
Ida Nurhaida and the team successfully obtained grants from Erasmus+ to establish a Cybersecurity Consortium comprising universities from both Europe and Asia, encompassing Spain, Croatia, Cyprus, Indonesia, India, and Nepal. lecturers.name: Lathifah Alfat, S.T., M.T.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Informatics Department
lecturers.bio:
Lathifah Alfat, S.T., M.T. is an Assistant Professor and Senior Lecturer at the Department of Informatics, Universitas Pembangunan Jaya (UPJ), Indonesia. She earned her Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with a concentration in Information Technology from Diponegoro University and obtained her Master's degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Indonesia. With over six years of academic experience, she focuses on machine learning, natural language processing, and deep learning-based emotion analysis. One of her standout research projects utilized LSTM models to classify Indonesian public sentiment on COVID-19 vaccination through Twitter, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 99 percent.

She also participated in technology education programs like Indonesia Android Kejar, organized by Google Developers Group, where she mentored beginner Android developers who later earned national recognition. lecturers.name: Dr. Sri Wijayanti, S.Sos., M.Si
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Communication Science
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Sri Wijayanti completed her academic education in Communication Science at Airlangga University, Surabaya. She continued her Master's in Communication Science at the University of Indonesia and then took a Doctoral degree in Communication Science, also at the University of Indonesia. Sri has an interest in research in media studies and inclusive communication. She is also active in community service, especially educating children with special needs.
Her research interests are centered on media and communication studies, mainly focusing on gender representation, social issues, and the dynamics of digital platforms in Indonesia. Her publications highlight the portrayal of female and autistic characters in Indonesian and international films, feminist values in popular culture, and the framing of fatherhood and single motherhood in media. She has also explored online news framing during the COVID-19 pandemic, the role of Instagram in single-mother communities, ethical concerns around doxing on Twitter, and the communication strategies of political figures and government agencies on digital platforms such as TikTok. These topics reflect her broad engagement with narrative persuasion, representation, and social messaging in contemporary Indonesian media.

Some of the courses she has taught include Interpersonal Communication, Communication Psychology, Broadcasting Basics, Advertising, Introduction to Communication Technology, New Media and Society, Digital Videography, PR Media Production, Persuasive Communication, Ethics and Philosophy of Communication, Law and Ethics of the Journalism Profession, and Environmental Journalism. lecturers.name: Naurissa Biasini, S.Si., M.I.Kom.
lecturers.role: Head and Lecturer of Department of Communication Science
lecturers.bio:
Entering the world of education since being trusted as a Teaching Assistant at STIKOM-LSPR Jakarta for approximately one year made this woman, usually called Bias, fall in love with the learning and teaching process. Bias was trusted to accompany three lecturers for different courses: Media Relations, Media Production Workshop, and Investigative Reporting. During her undergraduate education, she was also active as a member of the London School Radio until she was trusted to run a broadcast program on PRambors Radio and RRI. During that time, Bias also actively studied Japanese until she was selected as one of the participants in the JENESYS 2.0 student exchange program.
Graduating from the undergraduate program, she continued her career in the communications industry as a Social Media Specialist and Business Development Manager at one of the non-formal educational institutions in Jakarta. In addition, she worked as a non-permanent lecturer at a private university while continuing her education in the Masters of Communication Science program at Pelita Harapan University.
Her research interests span media representation, digital communication, and social issues, focusing on gender, environmental awareness, and community-based education. Her publications highlight the shifting representations of femininity in Disney Princess films and Indonesian cinema, effective communication and digitalization in fostering tax compliance, and behavioral attitudes toward food waste reduction among urban communities. She has also explored the role of storytelling and visual reflection in educating children about anti-corruption, the significance of bio-pigments in addressing stunting and obesity, and organizations' social media communication strategies. Additionally, she has examined Indonesian mothers' communication styles around sexual education for boys. These works underscore her commitment to critically analyzing media portrayals, fostering ethical and inclusive communication, and empowering communities through education and technology.

lecturers.name: Reni Dyanasari, S.I.Kom., M.Si.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Communication Science
lecturers.bio:
Reni Dyanasari began her career as a communications practitioner. She has developed her expertise through professional experience in public relations, promotion, marketing planning, and branding for large companies in Jakarta and in one of the national mass media groups. Her excellence in practicing public relations concepts, including in event planning, became the primary provision that led her to pursue a Masters degree and dedicate her time and energy as a lecturer at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. Reni actively teaches various courses in the field of communication, especially public relations, and continues to be involved in research and community service relevant to communication issues in urban communities and new media. As an educator, she also provides training and workshops for students, employees, and communities, demonstrating her commitment to integrating theory and practice sustainably in communication science. In addition to her professional career and dedication to higher education, Reni has a strong research interest in marketing communication, disaster risk communication, digital media literacy, and urban family communication. Her publications include discussions on Indonesian place branding through the Wonderful Indonesia campaign, risk communication in the context of natural disasters, digital marketing training for entrepreneurs during the pandemic, and the influence of the "Stay at Home" campaign on public health behavior. She is also involved in community service, focusing on organizational communication through social media content production training and education on bio-pigments for stunting and obesity prevention. Urban family communication as a foundation for tolerance is also a topic she researches, demonstrating her commitment to strategic communication issues that contribute to social, economic, and cultural development in Indonesia.

lecturers.role: Head of Student Affairs and Alumni Affairs and Communication Science Lecturer
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Ronald Maraden Parlindungan Silalahi, S.S., M.Hum. A lecturer at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, he holds a doctoral and master's degree in Humanities Studies from the University of Indonesia. His academic works have been published in reputable internationally indexed journals and presented at national and international congresses. Dr. Silalahi has won awards at international seminars, including the Ontario International Development Agency and the Asia-Pacific Research in Social Sciences and Humanities. In addition, he is an active editorial member and reviewer for reputable national and international journals. He has received several research grants, including the Doctoral Dissertation Research Grant, the International Indexed Publication Grant for Student Final Projects (PITTA), Funding for Independent Learning Policy Research on Campus Freedom, and Community Service Based on Private University Research Results.

His previous work examines the continuity of Pancasila in the Indonesian education system, reflecting a broad commitment to critical inquiry and the sociocultural dimensions of language and communication in various educational settings.

lecturers.name: Bakti Abdillah Putra, S.H.Int., M.Int.Comm.
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Communication Science
lecturers.bio:
Bakti Abdillah Putra completed his bachelor's degree in International Relations from Padjadjaran University and his master's degree in International Communication from Macquarie University, Australia. Since graduating with his master's degree, Bakti has been actively teaching communication studies, which shows his commitment to deepening and sharing knowledge in this field.

His publications include an analysis of interpersonal dynamics in Indonesian films, the impact of synchronous and asynchronous learning modes during the pandemic, and students' acceptance of cases of sexual harassment in academic settings. lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Communication Science

Slamet Budiharjo, S.I.Kom., M.A. completed his Masters at Universitas Gadjah Mada Yogyakarta in the Cultural and Media Studies Study Program. Budi is experienced in producing feature films and documentaries and has been a speaker/trainer in audio-visual production training at Studio Audio Visual Puskat Yogyakarta for almost two decades. In addition, he has worked in video production and audio-visual media production workshops and has been a lecturer at several campuses in Yogyakarta.

lecturers.name: Ratna Puspita, S.Sos, M.Si
lecturers.role: Lecturer of Department of Communication Science
lecturers.bio:
Ratna Puspita, S.Sos, M.Si is a dedicated academic, completing her Masters (S2) in Communication Science from the University of Indonesia. Ratna has expanded her knowledge in the field of communication, especially in online journalism and digital audiences. As a professional journalist for sixteen years, Ratna has rich experience covering various topics, ranging from urban affairs to politics. Since her career as a lecturer, Ratna has proven her dedication to education, teaching courses related to journalism and conducting research in various aspects of digital communication. In addition, she is also active in community service, especially in improving communication literacy at various levels of society.
Ratna's research interests center on social and digital media communication, gender representation, and identity negotiation in the contemporary media landscape. Her publications explore various topics, including the mediamorphosis of newspapers in the digital era, the role of social media in counter-radicalization, and the dynamics of social and mobile media use in online journalism. She also analyzes the commodification of gender in advertising, the depiction of metrosexual men and the hijab in advertising, and audience interpretations of plastic surgery in Korean dramas. Ratna's subsequent research has expanded into digital activism, highlighted in her work on symbolic interactions around pro-Palestinian imagery, identity negotiations in urban gym communities, and role-playing subcultures on Twitter. Her dedication to understanding these intersections demonstrates a rich and evolving perspective on how media and digital communication shape cultural, social, and gender identities in modern Indonesia.

Her dedication to maintaining a strong academic record, coupled with her involvement in organizational activities, paved the way for her to graduate with honors (Cum Laude) and gain recognition for her outstanding academic achievements. After gaining valuable experience in Business Development at a startup company and a master's degree in communication science, Fasya pursued her passion for education by returning to her alma mater, UPJ, as a lecturer. Now, as a dedicated educator, she imparts her public relations, event management, environmental communication, and public speaking knowledge and plays a vital role in student management at UPJ. Fasya's commitment to academic excellence and her role in leadership, including being an important part of the UPJ Alumni Association, confirms her contributions to the academic world, her love for the student world, and her professionalism.
Fasya's research interests center on media communication, digital marketing, and the relationship between culture and digital literacy in contemporary society. lecturers.name: Suci Marini Novianty, S.I.P., M.Si.
lecturers.role: Program Secretary and Communication Science Lecturer
lecturers.bio:
Suci Marini Novianty is a lecturer and researcher in the Communication Studies Program at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya. She completed her undergraduate education at the Department of Communication Studies, Faculty of Social and Political Sciences, Universitas Gadjah Mada. Then, she continued her master's education at the Communication Studies Program at Universitas Indonesia. Before joining Universitas Pembangunan Jaya, Suci was a public communication consultant and social media researcher.
Suci's research interests include leadership communication, political image, early childhood education, and digital ethics, focusing on how these areas are interrelated in the dynamic Indonesian socio-cultural context. Her publications include an analysis of President Jokowi's leadership through Goldhaber's charisma framework, exploring Jokowi's political image on online news platforms, and developing emotional education tools for infants. lecturers.name: Prof. Dr. Ir. Agustinus Agus Setiawan, S.T., M.T., IPM
lecturers.role: Vice Rector for Academic and Student Affairs and Lecturer
lecturers.bio:
Dr. Agustinus Agus Setiawan was born in Semarang. Agus completed his bachelor's degree in civil engineering at Soegijapranata Catholic University Semarang. He received a Masters in Engineering from the Bandung Institute of Technology, with a concentration in Structural Engineering. Further, he received his Doctorate from Tarumanagara University, with research in Artificial Intelligence Methods on non-cement geopolymer concrete materials. Agus also has the professional title of Intermediate Professional Engineer (IPM). After graduating from undergraduate school, Agus served as a permanent lecturer at his alma mater university for approximately 9 years, until 2008. After being involved in the construction world at a national structural contractor and consultant company for almost 3 years, Agus decided to return to the world of education as a full faculty member at Universitas Pembangunan Jaya.
Agustinus' research interests focus on the innovation and enhancement of concrete technology, especially in geopolymer concrete, its mechanical properties, and sustainable practices. His publications extensively explore the influence of natural and industrial waste materials—such as coconut fiber, eggshell powder, marble waste, and seashells—on the compressive and tensile strength, workability, and density of geopolymer concrete mixtures. His work also includes predictive modeling of concrete strength using statistical and machine learning methods, alongside structural performance analysis of existing buildings using techniques like pushover analysis. Furthermore, Agustinus has actively contributed to community-based research, including revitalizing historical libraries and improving environmental conditions in educational settings, highlighting a holistic approach to civil engineering that balances technical innovation with social and environmental sustainability.

lecturers.name: Prof. Elisabeth Rukmini, S.Si., M.Sc., Ph.D.
lecturers.role: Rector and Lecturer of Department of Civil Engineering
lecturers.bio:
Elisabeth is an experienced lecturer with a strong track record in educational management. She has expertise in Mentoring, Strategic Planning, Data Analytics, Lectures, Public Speaking, Microsoft Office, and Research. Elisabeth is an experienced researcher focused on active learning and higher education policy. She is a strong education professional with a Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) focused on Chemistry education from Miami University, Ohio, USA. Elisabeth furthers her expertise in Social Impact Measurement and holds a "Level 1 Associate Practitioner" certification. The Level 1 Associate Practitioner certification is the first step in the SVI Practitioner Pathway. SVI practitioners develop their skills, knowledge, and practice in social value, impact management, and the practical application of the SVI framework in social impact assessment and Social Return On Investment (SROI). Elisabeth pursued the Loop Corporate Coaching Certification (LCCC) and is a certified coach to continue her passion for developing others. She had the opportunity to visit Tamkang University in Taiwan for a post-doctoral study and learned about Futures Studies. Elisabeth loves helping others achieve more, even for the future.
Elisabeth's research interests span a range of interdisciplinary issues in education, chemistry, society, and learning technology. Her publications highlight themes such as innovation and validation of learning instruments, chemistry applications as a non-invasive health tool, and evidence-based program evaluation. Some of her work focuses on adapting psychometric instruments into Bahasa Indonesia, such as the Volunteer Functions Inventory and the Attitude Toward the Subject of Chemistry Inventory, demonstrating her concern for local cultural and educational contexts. Her qualitative research in higher education demonstrates her commitment to sustainable and socially impactful educational innovation.

Untuk menghasilkan lulusan dengan kompetensi tersebut, maka keunggulan PS PPAr UPJ difokuskan pada kekhasan kedekatan dengan dunia industri yang terlihat melalui penerapan Living Lab, Forward Thinking, dan Entrepreuneurship. Living lab adalah kekhasan PS PPAr UPJ yang memiliki kedekatan dengan industri di bawah naungan Grup Pembangunan Jaya, dimana mahasiswa dapat terlibat langsung dalam industri tersebut sebagai bagian dari pembelajaran. Forward thinking adalah kekhasan PS PPAr UPJ dimana setelah lulus dapat siap terap dan sejalan dengan industri arsitektur di dunia nyata. Untuk mendukung kekhasan forward thinking tersebut dalam pembelajaran metode desain generatif digunakan untuk mengembangkan desain yang paling efisien dan berkelanjutan dari berbagai kemungkinan. Entrepreneurship memberikan penekanan etika keprofesian dan membiasakan pola pikir kewirausahaan sebagai calon arsitek dalam pengambilan keputusan rancangan. faq.pertanyaan: Berapa biaya pendaftaran awal di UPJ?
faq.jawaban: Biaya pendaftaran formulir adalah Rp 200.000 untuk jalur reguler. Untuk jalur beasiswa tertentu dan promo gelombang dini (Early Bird), biaya formulir adalah GRATIS.

faq.pertanyaan: Apakah biaya kuliah di UPJ bisa dicicil?
faq.jawaban: Ya, UPJ menyediakan skema cicilan pembayaran uang masuk dan biaya semesteran untuk memudahkan calon mahasiswa baru.

faq.pertanyaan: Apakah ada jaminan kerja setelah lulus dari UPJ?
faq.jawaban: UPJ memiliki program *Jaminan Kerja di Grup Jaya* bagi lulusan terbaik yang memenuhi standar kompetensi dan prestasi akademik di lebih dari 17 anak perusahaan Pembangunan Jaya.

faq.pertanyaan: Bagaimana ketentuan jika saya diterima di PTN?
faq.jawaban: Jika calon mahasiswa dinyatakan diterima di PTN Klaster 1 Kemendikbudristek (seperti UI, ITB, UGM, IPB, ITS, Undip, Unpad, dll) melalui jalur SNBP atau SNBT, seluruh uang semester 1 (Uang Masuk/Pangkal, SPP, dan SKS) akan dikembalikan penuh sesuai syarat ketentuan.

faq.pertanyaan: Apa keunikan UPJ dibanding universitas lain?
faq.jawaban: Keunikan utama UPJ adalah didukung penuh oleh Pembangunan Jaya Group dengan ekosistem 'Living Laboratory' (laboratorium hidup), kurikulum berbasis Urban Studies (Kelas KOTA - Kelas Open To All), program Jaya Softskills Development Program (JSDP) dengan 1000 poin softskills, serta akses langsung ke Stasiun KRL Jurangmangu dan Bintaro Xchange Mall.

faq.pertanyaan: Apakah jurusan DKV dan Arsitektur mensyaratkan tidak buta warna?
faq.jawaban: Ya, prodi Arsitektur, Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV), Desain Produk, dan Teknik Sipil mewajibkan bebas buta warna total/parsial demi kelancaran perkuliahan teknis dan desain visual.
